errors.text_span: При стойност 10% по оста X, кривата достига приблизително 70% по оста Y.
errors.evidence: The description states that at an X-axis value of 10%, the curve reaches approximately 70% on the Y-axis. However, the plot clearly shows the line passing below the 70% tick mark, at a value closer to 65-67%.

errors.text_span: завършва в края на графиката при стойност 100% по оста X, където достига точно 100% по оста Y
errors.evidence: This phrasing inaccurately simplifies the end of the curve. The line appears to reach 100% on the Y-axis before the 100% mark on the X-axis (around 90-95%) and then plateaus. Stating that it ends at X=100% where it reaches Y=100% is misleading, as the value of 100% on the Y-axis is reached earlier and then maintained.
